primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.
The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its pasture lands, and Tabor with its pasture lands;
Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;
So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.
The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),
These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.

review.identityCheckJa: 6:1・6:16・23:6はレビの子として個人名を挙げ、6:47もレビから続く系譜の祖先として名指す。その他の割当用例はMerari descendants/Levite groupを表す。
review.spoilerCheckJa: 後代のレビ人集団の職務や割当地は常時欄に含めず、個人Merariとの同定と集団用例を分けて記録した。

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: 固定WEB 1CH6:1 and 6:16 name Merari in the sons-of-Levi genealogy, matching article subject.
wikipediaCheck.locator: Lead lines 115–116 identifies Merari as one of Levi’s sons and patriarchal founder of the Merarites.

review.remainingUncertaintyJa: 「メラリの子ら」とする用例は子孫・レビ人集団を指す。個人カードに直接の個人行為として割り当てない。
